content.heading: Right to equality
content.text: Article 14: the State shall not deny to any person equality before the law or the equal protection of the laws within the territory of India. Articles 15 and 16 prohibit specified discrimination and contain enabling clauses for special provisions and reservations. Article 17 abolishes untouchability. Article 18 abolishes titles (military and academic distinctions excepted). Read official clause text under provision:india:constitution-art-14 through art-18.
